text:
eli_support: heads up — acme-prod just opened an escalation. they say audit logs are missing for 2026-03-10 02:00–02:45 UTC and they're seeing duplicate billing lines for the same API calls. customer is pushing for a timeline and root cause.

julia_ops: ack. what's the customer request id or example request ids?

eli_support: sent two request ids in the ticket: req_9f1a2b and req_9f1a2c. they saw 500 errors around 02:12 then retries; invoice shows token usage twice for that window.

mike_eng_infra: pinging infra — I can check request ingress + LB traces and our audit event ingestion. @security_oncall do we have any KMS/HSM maintenance or rotation around that time?

security_oncall: not scheduled. quick check of HSM logs shows a short GC pause at 02:13 UTC on the backup appliance, but no key material ops recorded. curious if audit pipeline backfilled later and customer missed those entries.

rosa_finance: can we get the invoice lines? if the same request ids are recorded twice we need to reconcile immediately before customer escalates to legal.

eli_support: pasted snippet from the customer ticket (sanitized):
```
"At 02:12 our integration returned 500. We retried and received 200. Later invoice shows both attempts billed. Also, audit exports for 02:00-02:45 missing events for our org.
Request ids: req_9f1a2b, req_9f1a2c"
```

mike_eng_infra: I'm pulling the ingress logs now. initial hypothesis: transient proxy error caused client retry; our billing dedupe normally groups identical request ids from same client within 5m — so if retries had new ids they could be billed separately. I'll check tokenization pipeline for double-counting though.

julia_ops: audit pipeline status at the time?

deploy-bot: audit-collector: ingestion lag spike detected 2026-03-10T02:10:00Z — 02:20:00Z; peak backlog ~1.8h. downstream exporter resumed normal throughput at 02:45:12Z.

security_oncall: that explains missing events window. exporter lag looks like the reason audit entries weren't in the customer export. need to trace root cause for the lag—queue pressure? sudden throughput?

mike_eng_infra: ingress logs show 500 responses from model-proxy cluster at 02:12:07 for req_9f1a2b, then client retried and got 200 for req_9f1a2c at 02:12:35. Both requests consumed tokens. Billing service saw both events because retries used distinct request ids.

rosa_finance: ok finance note: if both attempts consumed compute, we usually bill both. but we can offer a one-time credit if it's on our side. need approval from cs and ops after root cause.

anne_cs: customer wants a formal timeline and whether data retention/audit scope was impacted. propose: (1) confirm missing export window and root cause, (2) confirm whether any KMS/HSM key material operations occurred (affects audit scope), (3) provide a credit offer for duplicate billing if it was service-impact. Can we commit to updates?

security_oncall: KMS/HSM check: no key rotations, no key access events tied to their org in that period. HSM GC pause noted but not a key operation. So scope of audit concern = ingestion/exporter lag only, not KMS access.

mike_eng_infra: root cause for lag: exporter downstream DB I/O saturation due to a burst of large admin exports + our nightly retention job overlap. Backpressure built up in audit-collector queue leading to ~1.8h backlog. I've queued a mitigation PR to add rate-based backpressure and backfill orchestration.

eli_support: timeline draft for customer:
- 02:10–02:45 UTC: audit ingestion experienced elevated lag; exporter resumed at 02:45 and backlog was backfilled by 04:15 UTC.
- 02:12 UTC: transient 500 from model-proxy for req_9f1a2b; client retried and received 200 (req_9f1a2c). Both attempts consumed tokens and were billed.
- No KMS/HSM key access or rotation occurred for their org during window.

julia_ops: proposed next steps (internal):
1) eng_infra to complete PR and deploy hotfix to prevent exporter saturation (ETA 24h).
2) ops to add alerting on audit-collector queue depth (ETA 2h).
3) cs + finance to draft customer-facing note and credit offer (if agreed) (ETA 4h).
4) security to prepare statement on KMS scope (ETA 1h).

rosa_finance: finance ok with a one-time credit for the duplicate token bill if eng confirms the 500 was on our side. mark tentative credit amount = cost of second attempt only.

anne_cs: I'll draft customer message and propose: apology + timeline + technical summary + credit offer. We'll ask for ack and whether they want full audit re-export after backfill.

mike_eng_infra: assigning myself to follow up. I'll post a short RCA draft after the hotfix is merged.

eli_support: thanks all. @security_oncall can you post a short sentence for customer-facing \"no KMS/HSM access\" line?

security_oncall: \"We have confirmed there were no KMS or HSM key access or rotation events associated with your organization during the impacted window. The missing audit entries were caused by transient ingestion/exporter backlog and not by key management operations.\"

eli_support: perfect. i'll send to customer and flag support ticket as escalated -> pending eng root cause and credit confirmation.

mike_eng_infra: updating: hotfix PR merged to staging, deploying now. will monitor exporter backlog and follow up with metrics.

julia_ops: I'll add queue-depth alert and run a one-off re-export for the customer's org once backfill completes.

eli_support: closing loop: customer replied appreciating the quick triage; requested re-export and confirmation once credit applied. I'll keep thread open until credit applied and re-export done. :thumbsup:
